This variable then calculates mean of inundation intensities of all pixels.

column19: Aug-2026: Definition matches Assam, Odisha and Himachal ("Mean slope of the region" / degrees / NASADEM), but Bihar VALUES ARE NOT USABLE AS DEGREES. Bihar 65.6-88.2 (median 82.9) and Assam 70-90 (median 85) vs Himachal 4.5-35.1 (median 23.2); a median slope of 83 deg is impossible on the Gangetic plain. Ranking is correct (Kaimur/Gaya hills highest, floodplain lowest; corr with elevation +0.398, same sign as Himachal) so this is an inflated-gradient/units problem saturating arctan near 90, not an inversion. visible_on_platform set to n pending re-extraction via ee.Terrain.slope on native NASADEM. Not read by any Bihar factor script, so no risk score is affected.
